observations: Electric sewing machine shown in all photos; white body with control dials and stitch selection panel.
Photo 0 shows a brand/model area that appears to read “RICCAR” on the front panel.
Photo 1 shows “SINGER” on the top bar and “Senco” and “Indigo 6” on the right side.
Photo 2 shows “NOVAMATIC” and “NM 868A” on the front/side label.
No clear photo of the needle area close-up, presser foot, or the machine running.
No visible accessories (foot pedal, power cable, bobbins, needles, manual) shown clearly.

claims.claim: Industrial electric sewing machine is use for sewing of clothes and murtipurpuse uses
claims.evidence: Photos show an electric home-style sewing machine with stitch programs, but do not prove it is “industrial” duty, nor show it sewing different materials.

risks.risk: Brand/model confusion: different photos show different brand/model markings (Riccar vs Singer vs Novamatic NM 868A vs Indigo 6). This can mean the wrong machine is being advertised or parts/labels are mismatched.
risks.proof: Ask for a single clear photo of the exact model plate/label (close-up) and the full front panel text, plus a photo of the underside/serial label if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used electric sewing machine with uncertain model/condition (worst case: not guaranteed for heavy/industrial use).

risks.risk: Not tested: no video of it sewing, no confirmation of stitch function, tension, or motor/pedal working.
risks.proof: Request a short video of it running while sewing a straight line on fabric (and ideally a second fabric type).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working or untested (worst case: needs service).

risks.risk: Missing/uncertain accessories: foot pedal, power cable, bobbins, needles, and presser feet are not shown clearly.
risks.proof: Ask for photos showing: foot pedal, power cable, bobbin case, bobbins, needles, and at least one presser foot attachment.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/without guaranteed accessories (worst case: buyer must source missing parts).

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible: worn belts/gears, noisy motor, bent needle bar, or damaged feed mechanism.
risks.proof: Request a video showing the needle moving and the feed dogs engaging while sewing; also a close-up of the needle area and presser foot.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible wear (worst case: may require maintenance).

proof_requests: One clear close-up photo of the exact model plate/serial label (the text that determines the model).
Video of the machine sewing (straight stitch) with the foot pedal pressed—show needle movement and fabric feed.
Photos of included accessories: foot pedal, power cable, bobbins/bobbin case, needles, and presser feet.
Close-up photo of the needle area/presser foot and the feed dogs.
response.reason: The photos show an electric sewing machine, but the brand/model markings conflict across photos and there is no proof it works (no running video) or that it includes key accessories. Without that, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
